# Management UI

> A modular, plugin-first admin interface for Opencast. A thin shell hosts
> routing, auth, and layout; every visible feature ships as a plugin.
> Organisations customize by adding plugins and themes, not by forking.
> pnpm + Turborepo monorepo; React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.

## Start here — the docs are organised by who is reading

- Try it → `docs/quickstart.md` — the UI in a browser against an Opencast you already run
- Use it → `docs/use/index.md` — find a video, edit metadata, upload, manage series
- Run it → `docs/operate/index.md` — install the bundles, `config.json`, backend keys, upgrade
- Extend it → `docs/extend/index.md` — write a plugin, add a GraphQL field, ship it
- Contribute → `docs/contribute/index.md` — set up the repo, pass the gate, open a PR

Look-up material sits beside those, deliberately dense: `docs/reference/`
(architecture, contracts, configuration model, ADRs, open follow-ups).

AI agents: `AGENTS.md` is the operational rulebook — pre-flight checklist,
plugin layout, import boundaries, the required contract test, the config-slice
rule, the changeset rule, and the `pnpm verify` gate. Read it before changing
anything under `plugins/`, `packages/`, or `apps/`.

## Repo layout

### Apps (`apps/`) — consume plugins, never the other way around

- `shell` — the only entry point; boots the plugin system, owns routing/auth/layout
- `playground` — dev-only single-plugin sandbox

### Packages (`packages/`) — layered; lower layers never depend on higher

- Layer 3 (Application): `app-runtime`, `providers`, `vite-config`, `ui-config`
- Layer 2 (Integration): `query`, `router`, `ui`, `remote-plugin-loader`, `plugin-testing`
- Layer 1 (Foundation): `plugin-system`, `store`, `i18n`
- Layer 0 (Core): `utils`, `typescript-config`, `eslint-config`, `tailwind-config`

Published under the `@oc-mui/*` scope. Wrapped libraries are consumed via the
facade only (`@oc-mui/router`, `@oc-mui/query`, `@oc-mui/i18n`, `@oc-mui/store`),
never directly.

### Plugins (`plugins/`) — built-in, ship with the repo

- `core` — mandatory infrastructure plugin: shared extension-point identifiers and defaults
- `core-episodes`, `core-series`, `core-upload` — the built-in feature apps
- `admin-marketplace` — optional marketplace UI for remote plugins
- `example` — minimal brand-neutral reference plugin
- `assets` — shared static assets; not a runtime plugin

Org or community plugins live outside the repo and mount at dev time under
`.local-plugins/<name>/` (gitignored, same layout as in-tree plugins). See
`docs/extend/distribution.md` for how plugins ship in production.

### Backend (`backend/`, `assemblies/`)

OSGi bundles deployed into Opencast: a config bundle that serves
`plugins.json` and discovers plugin JARs, a GraphQL bundle that adds the
`mui*` extensions, plus a Karaf feature. See `docs/extend/backend-bundles.md`.

## Contracts

Manifest, Runtime API, Theme, Config, Shared Runtime Dependencies, and GraphQL
Operation Naming are frozen and versioned in `docs/reference/contracts.md`.
That page owns the contract names and their version numbers — do not restate a
version anywhere else.

## Key commands

- `pnpm dev` — run the shell locally
- `pnpm verify` — the canonical pre-push gate; its step list and the fast
  inner-loop variants live once in `AGENTS.md` → Pre-push gate
- `pnpm create-plugin <name>` — scaffold a plugin under `.local-plugins/`
  (`--in-tree` for a built-in one)
- `pnpm changeset` — required for any change to a versioned package
- `pnpm docs:build` / `docs:lint` / `docs:ownership` — the docs checks

## Other root files

- `README.md` — GitHub landing page, routes into the five entries above
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — short pointer into `docs/contribute/`
- `SECURITY.md`, `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` — vulnerability reporting and conduct
